ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
An underground line has the six stations A, B, C, D, E and F. The train stops at every station. After reaching the end of the line $A$ or $F$ the train continues in the opposite direction. The train conductor starts his journey in station B. His first stop is in station C. In which station will be his $46^{\text {th}}$ stop?

method.method_draft: Model the line with coordinates from the image: A=0, B=1, C=2, D=3, E=4, F=5. From the text, the conductor starts at B and first goes toward C, so after k stops the unreflected position would be 1+k. Because the train reflects at endpoints, use a period of 2×5=10 and fold positions by r=(1+k) mod 10, with station coordinate r if r≤5 and 10−r if r>5. For k=46, r=(1+46) mod 10=7, so the folded coordinate is 10−7=3, which corresponds to station D.
